descriptionHtml:
Candidate N37 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

A census row whose name cannot be read disappears without a word: the scan sheet, the list and the chart have no row, no 'unclear' flag and no message, so the physician believes the whole list was added while a patient is missing

Tickets: TFA-92580 AC 6 (rejected by qa) · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: local (25acd727)

Note: Both contexts (TC-02/S28, 5/11). The client drops every row whose name is under 3 characters (useResidentListScan.ts / the Hospital scan sheet); the prompt has no 'unclear' field. Also: a model that writes '[unclear]' would add a patient named '[unclear]' with no rename step (suggestion).

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S28 What the physician sees for a missing field and an unreadable name (scan sheet, list and chart, both contexts)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 6; TFA-92580 How it works 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U8 AI Check: on a list with one hard-to-read name, the app flags that name as unclear and does not guess a plausible-looking one. … (UAT TC-02 AI Check; TFA-92580 AC 6; UAT 3.2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Fresh physician on the local stack with the two fixture patients

When Hospital: scan h-f1-missing-fields.png, add all rows and open QA Hazel's chart; scan h-u1-ink-blot.jpg and try to add all rows. Nursing Home: scan n-f1-missing-fields.png, add all and open QA Vetch's chart; scan n-u1-ink-blot.jpg and try to add all

Then A missing MRN, room, DOB or unit shows blank with a not-on-photo flag. It never shows an app-made value ('MRN-…', 'SNF-…') or a neighbour's room. The unreadable row (room 605 / unit Birch 15) is visibly flagged on the scan sheet. After adding, the list shows no confident made-up name for that row, or the row cannot be added until it is edited (Q2)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints. No 'MRN-' or 'SNF-' on the charts. Hazel's chart shows no 'Room 41' (a shifted row). The unclear sheet row shows a marker. The list after adding holds the four legible names, and the row-605 / Birch-15 entry carries the S14 marker or the exact hidden name (rowCheck); any other name there is a guess. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S28 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (mocked rows with blanks and one unclear row)); secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Local spec pl-tc02-local.spec.ts 'TC-02 S28'; reads answered as the census prompts instruct a model ('Use an empty string for any single field you truly cannot read'): H-F1 (Hazel no room, Gum no age, Ivy no diagnosis, no MRN column), H-U1 (room 605's name ''), N-F1 (Vetch no DOB, Willow no unit, no MRN column), N-U1 (Birch 15's name ''). Judged 5/11. Held: H-F1 sheet has no app-made value; Hazel's chart 'Room — · 66y · —' with 'Syncope', no MRN-, no neighbour's room; blanks stored as '—' / no age, not invented; N-F1 sheet has no SNF-/MRN-. FAILED: (1) U8 ×4: the unreadable row is silently dropped in both contexts: the client discards a row whose name is shorter than 3 characters (scannedPatient.ts isLikelyPatientRow / useResidentListScan.ts extractedResidents), so the sheet shows '4 patients found' / '4 residents found' with no room-605 / Birch-15 row and no 'unclear' marker, and after adding there is no such patient and no message; neither the vision prompts nor the client have any 'unclear' flag (AC 6 'unclear names are flagged' is not built); (2) U7 ×2: Vetch's chart and all three N-F1 residents carry app-made SNF- MRNs (Q5). Recorded: Q2 a missing room / MRN shows as '—' (whether a dash is a flag is Q2); Q13 admitDate 'Oct 17' and dayNum 1 are filled for a sheet with no such columns; if a read marked the name '[unclear]', the sheet would list it as an ordinary ticked row ('5 patients found') and adding would create a patient named '[unclear]' with no edit step. The real model's handling of an unreadable name could not be read on dev (B01).

Product issue: A census row whose name cannot be read disappears from the scan without any warning, so that patient is silently missing from the list; nothing is ever flagged as unclear.

Evidence: 10 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: permission-add-patient, synthetic-media, oracle-row, oracle-controls, lane-b-scan-ai. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
